chunks: Only God has the knowledge of the Hour. He sends rain from the heavens, and knows what is in the mothers' wombs. No one knows what he will do on the morrow; no one knows in what land he will die. Surely God knows and is cognisant.

key_terms.السَّاعَةِ: The Hour (time of resurrection or end of the world)

ai.seo_question: What are the four things only God knows according to this verse?
ai.summary: Known as the 'Verse of Five Things' (Āyat al-Khams), this passage is central to Shia eschatology and tafsir, particularly in Al-Kafi, where it is often cited to demonstrate the Prophet's and Imams' knowledge of the unseen through divine grant. It underscores the distinction between absolute divine omniscience and human uncertainty regarding their own future, serving as a reminder for spiritual preparation and moral accountability.
